name: Cable Decline Fly
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a decline between two low pulleys and secure your feet under the pads.
Lie face up holding both handles above your lower chest with palms facing each other and elbows softly bent.
Open your arms in wide arcs until you feel a comfortable stretch across your chest.
Sweep both handles back together above your lower chest, squeezing your pecs at the top.
tips: Stop opening your arms when your upper arms reach torso level.
Keep a fixed slight bend in your elbows so the movement stays a fly rather than a press.
